policy: Gate G3 grades computed classes and token values per core route across the desktop and browser hosts.
A delta passes only through an entry here. A delta with no entry fails the gate; that is the point.
Every entry names the exact surface it excuses: route (or "*"), kind, and the selector/key/property keys that identify it.
Every entry carries `why` (what the deliberate difference is and which host mechanism causes it) and `reviewed_by`.
An entry whose delta no longer occurs fails the gate as stale. Delete it: an allowlist that outlives its delta hides the next regression.
Prefer fixing the host over adding an entry. An entry is for a difference that is meant to be visible.
